name: Forty-Day Sadhana Intensive
summary: Forty days of silent, self-paced practice for up to 40 experienced practitioners at a yoga ashram, with a teacher present and daily instruction. Long practice days. $1,200.
description:
The forty-day intensive is for people who have practised for years and want a long stretch of silence with a teacher who will push them.

**Format**
There is no group timetable. Each practitioner works out a daily sadhana with Guruji at the start (asana, pranayama, japa, sitting) and then holds it for forty days on their own schedule. Most people practise six to eight hours a day. Guruji is in the hall each morning and gives instruction to whoever is there; individual conversations happen at his discretion, usually every few days.

**Silence**
Full mauna for forty days. Practitioners eat, work, and practise in silence. Contact with Guruji is by note or in the daily instruction period.

**Demand**
Severe. Long pranayama, long sitting, early rising, and the accumulating weight of silence. People with less than five years of daily practice are not accepted.

**Cost**
$1,200 for forty days, meals and dormitory included. It is subsidised by the ashram.
practical: Forty days, beginning on the new moon in February. $1,200. Up to 40 practitioners in dormitories. Two meals daily, sattvic. Bring practice clothing, a shawl, your own mat and props. Nearest airport Sacramento; shuttle on arrival day. Phones held at the office. Application with a practice history and a teacher's reference.
